title: HB 300 'Amendments to Election Law' (2025 General) — Last-four ID digits on mail-ballot return envelope; opt-in mail ballots from 2029; SAVE registration; many election-administration parts
operative_text:
Mail ballots: last four digits of licence/ID number on return envelope; SSN last-four as alternate: requires a registered voter who has a Utah driver license or a state identification card to place the last four digits of the card's number on the return envelope
Signature comparison until 2029 if digits not entered: until 2029, permits a voter's identity to be verified using signature comparison, if the voter doesn't enter the digits
From 2029, voter without UT licence/ID/SS card may enclose photocopy of certain ID: may provide identification by including a photocopy of certain forms of identification in the return envelope
From 2029 voter with no listed ID must vote in person unless exception: requires the voter to vote in person, unless the voter qualifies for certain exceptions
From 2029 no mail ballot unless requested; request lasts 8 years: a voter will not receive a ballot by mail unless the voter requests to receive a ballot by mail
Lt. governor: evaluate registration records by address for anomalies; investigate undeliverable-ballot registrations: develop a procedure to evaluate voter registration records based on addresses to identify potential anomalies
Register with SAVE (federal citizenship verification): register with the Systematic Alien Verification for Entitlements program
Agreement with federal courts for jury-disqualification notices (convictions, non-citizen): the courts will notify the state of individuals who are disqualified from jury service due to criminal convictions or non-citizen status
Ways to request/renew mail ballot (register, online, licence application, polling place): provides that a voter may request, or renew a request, to receive a ballot by mail
Voter registration forms amended for ballot notifications and mailed ballot request: amends voter registration forms relating to
Assisting a voter at a polling place: modifies requirements for an individual to assist a voter to vote at a polling place
Return envelope warnings; emergency ballot; ballot processing: modifies provisions relating to obtaining and returning an emergency ballot
Exception to mail ballots from a Utah location when USPS centre is out of state: creates an exception to the requirement that the bulk of ballots initially mailed to voters must be mailed from a location in Utah
Expanded Lt. governor duties on voter database; technical changes: expands the duties of the lieutenant governor in relation to maintaining the voter registration database
Appropriation: This bill appropriates $2,000,000 in operating and capital budgets for fiscal year 2026, all of which is from the General Fund.
Repeals: 20A-3a-101 ... 53-3-801 (repealed)
